🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 28, 2026

Moon, in Aries, holds a sextile to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Fire begins and is billed in the same gesture. Mars has not been in Cancer for four weeks.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Mars squares you from Leo, and something has to give way. Fixed earth pays to hold on. After three weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Libra as a guest. Moon sextiles you from Aries: a door left ajar. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. Since Mercury crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Aries unannounced. Sun in Libra squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Moon trines you from Aries, meeting no resistance. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Libra. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon in Aries sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Air that starts things, billed for starting. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Venus crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: what is kept and who keeps it merge. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Aries sides with you before you have argued. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. The sextile to Mercury that held a week ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon squares you from Aries, and the cost objects. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. A week ago Saturn was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Aries leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. From Scorpio, Venus makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.
